standard_prerequisites: the universal-introduction rule of natural deduction and its eigenvariable condition
core_obligations: Prove that if the constant c occurs in neither Gamma nor A(x) and Gamma proves A(c), then Gamma proves forall x A(x)
proof_roadmap: Take a derivation of A(c) from Gamma

Append one universal-introduction inference discharging the assumption involving c; since c occurs in neither Gamma nor A(x), the eigenvariable condition holds, giving a derivation of forall x A(x) from Gamma
difficulty_reason: A one-rule extension of a derivation; the eigenvariable condition is the entire content and is verified in the source.
